rows.definition: model.Session.PrefillContext ingests a prompt under the existing request context and one backend execution owner, returning last-token logits only on successful completion. The local partial-offload scalar HAL fallback observes cancellation between completed tokens; other selected operations retain their established boundary.
rows.distinction: An inference operation consuming an existing context, not requestCtx (an agentbench per-request context value), a new context identity, or a kernel-abort primitive. A cancelled partial session must be retired rather than reused as a completed prompt.

rows.definition: model.Session.PrefillNoLogitsContext advances the prompt prefix without returning output logits, while preserving the same existing request-context and backend-owner cancellation contract as PrefillContext. Only the local partial-offload scalar HAL token loop may stop between completed tokens.
rows.distinction: The prefix-only operation, not PrefillContext (which returns the last token distribution). A cancelled prefix is not a completed prompt or reusable snapshot; sequence, panel and EP operations retain their existing atomic boundary.
